pages.text:
15 Nov. Cousin Edmund says a Miss Orrin is coming on Tuesday. Father says the Orrins refused, in great-great-grandfather's day, and that's why there is no eighth chair. I asked what the eighth chair is for. Nobody would say.

16 Nov. Dr. Whitmore came early and argued with Edmund in the library for an hour. I heard "I'll go down with you, Edmund, but I won't count." I don't know what he meant either.

Tomorrow there's a dinner and I'm to wear the green.
